products.title: Yamaha Pacifica Electric Guitar
products.description: Professional electric guitar with a comfortable neck and versatile tone. Its balanced pickup setup handles everything from clean rhythm to heavy lead playing, making it a dependable choice for practice, recording, and live stages.

products.title: Fender Player Stratocaster
products.description: Classic electric guitar design suitable for practice, recording and live performance. Its bright, chimey single-coil tone and contoured body deliver the iconic Stratocaster sound that suits blues, rock, and pop players alike.

products.title: Gibson Les Paul Style Guitar
products.description: Powerful electric guitar built for rich sustain and expressive playing. Its thick, warm humbucker tone and solid body construction make it ideal for rock, blues, and lead work, from home practice to the big stage.

products.title: Ibanez RG Electric Guitar
products.description: Fast-playing electric guitar designed for modern players and stage performance. Its slim neck and low action make quick runs and technical solos effortless, while the powerful pickups deliver a tight, aggressive tone.

products.title: Yamaha F310 Acoustic Guitar
products.description: Steel-string acoustic guitar with a balanced sound for beginners and performers. Its full body produces a warm, clear tone with solid projection, and the comfortable neck makes it easy to learn on and enjoyable to play.

products.title: Fender FA-125 Acoustic Guitar
products.description: Affordable acoustic guitar with a comfortable feel and bright natural tone. Its dreadnought body gives a full, resonant sound for strumming and picking, making it a great starter guitar for home, campfire, or classroom use.

products.title: Classic Nylon String Guitar
products.description: Nylon-string classical guitar with a warm tone for fingerstyle playing. The soft nylon strings are gentle on the fingers and the wide neck leaves room for clean technique, perfect for classical, flamenco, and beginner lessons.

products.title: Marshall MG15 Guitar Amplifier
products.description: Compact practice amplifier with classic guitar amp character. It offers a simple control layout with clean and overdriven sounds, making it perfect for bedroom practice, small rehearsals, and learning new songs.

products.title: Fender Mustang LT25 Amplifier
products.description: Versatile modeling amplifier with multiple tones for home practice. It includes a wide range of built-in amp models and effects, along with an onboard tuner, so you can explore different styles without extra gear.

products.title: Boss Katana Mini Amplifier
products.description: Portable guitar amplifier for practice and small setups. Despite its small size it delivers a punchy, rich tone with built-in gain and effect options, and it can run on batteries, so you can play anywhere.

products.title: Yamaha P-125 Digital Piano
products.description: Portable digital piano with realistic piano feel and useful performance features. The weighted keys respond naturally to your touch, and the rich sampled piano sound suits students, home players, and stage use.

products.title: Casio CT-S300 Keyboard
products.description: Portable keyboard with beginner-friendly controls and a wide range of sounds. Its lightweight body and built-in rhythms make it easy to carry and fun to learn on, with plenty of tones to explore as you grow.

products.title: Roland FP-30X Digital Piano
products.description: Digital piano with expressive sound and weighted keys for serious practice. Its authentic piano response and Bluetooth connectivity let you play, learn with apps, and record, all in a compact modern design.

products.title: Korg Kross 2 Synthesizer
products.description: Flexible performance synthesizer for live playing and music production. It packs a huge library of sounds, a built-in sequencer, and a sturdy lightweight build, making it ideal for the stage, rehearsal room, and studio.

products.title: Alesis Recital 88-Key Piano
products.description: Full-size digital piano designed for students, practice and home performance. Its 88 semi-weighted keys give a comfortable playing feel, and the built-in voices and simple controls make it easy to start playing right away.

products.title: Yamaha Stage Custom Drum Kit
products.description: Full acoustic drum kit for rehearsal, recording and live performance. Its birch shells deliver a punchy, warm tone and strong projection, with reliable hardware that holds up for regular practice and gigs.

products.title: Pearl Roadshow Drum Kit
products.description: Complete drum set with hardware for beginners and developing drummers. It comes with everything needed to start playing, including cymbals, stands, and a throne, offering a balanced sound and great value for growing players.

products.title: Roland TD-07 Electronic Drums
products.description: Electronic drum kit with responsive pads and practice-friendly features. The natural-feeling pads and quiet playing make it great for apartments, with headphone support, built-in coaching tools, and a wide choice of kits.

products.title: Meinl Cajon
products.description: Compact wooden percussion instrument for acoustic sessions and performances. You sit on it and play with your hands to get deep bass tones and sharp snare-like slaps, so it is easy to carry and fits any setting.

products.title: Shure SM58 Vocal Microphone
products.description: Durable dynamic microphone suitable for vocals, rehearsal and live use. Its cardioid pattern reduces background noise and feedback, while the rugged build and clear, focused sound have made it a stage standard for decades.

products.title: Audio-Technica AT2020 Microphone
products.description: Condenser microphone designed for clear vocals, instruments and home recording. Its cardioid pattern captures detailed, natural sound while rejecting room noise, making it a popular pick for podcasts and project studios.

products.title: Rode NT1 Studio Microphone
products.description: Studio condenser microphone with detailed sound for recording applications. It has very low self-noise and a smooth, transparent tone, ideal for capturing vocals and acoustic instruments in a professional studio.

products.title: AKG P120 Condenser Microphone
products.description: Versatile condenser microphone for vocals, acoustic instruments and streaming. Its large diaphragm captures a clear, balanced sound, and the switchable pad and low-cut filter help control loud sources and unwanted noise.

products.title: JBL EON One Compact Speaker
products.description: Portable PA speaker for rehearsals, small events and live music. Its built-in mixer, battery-powered operation, and clear wide sound coverage make it easy to set up quickly wherever you perform.

products.title: Yamaha DBR12 Powered Speaker
products.description: Powerful active speaker designed for clear sound in live setups. Its 12-inch woofer and built-in amplifier deliver strong, detailed output, and the lightweight cabinet works well as a main speaker or stage monitor.

products.title: KRK Rokit 5 Studio Monitor
products.description: Nearfield studio monitor for mixing, production and accurate listening. Its tuned design offers punchy bass and clear highs, and the built-in EQ adjustments help you get a reliable sound even in small studios.

products.title: Audio-Technica ATH-M50x Headphones
products.description: Closed-back studio headphones with detailed sound for monitoring and listening. They offer deep, accurate bass and excellent isolation, plus a comfortable fit and detachable cables for long sessions.

products.title: Sony MDR-7506 Studio Headphones
products.description: Reliable closed-back headphones for recording and studio monitoring. Their clear, detailed sound and foldable lightweight design have made them a long-time favorite for engineers, vocalists, and videographers.

products.title: Sennheiser HD 280 Pro
products.description: Professional monitoring headphones with strong isolation for studio work. They block out outside noise effectively, deliver clear and accurate sound, and fold up compactly with comfortable pads for long sessions.

products.title: Boss DS-1 Distortion Pedal
products.description: Classic guitar effects pedal for adding distortion to electric guitar tones. It offers tone, level, and distortion controls to shape everything from light crunch to heavy saturation, all in a durable metal case.

products.title: Dunlop Cry Baby Wah Pedal
products.description: Expressive wah pedal for guitarists who want classic dynamic effects. Rocking the pedal sweeps the tone from thick bass to bright treble, creating the vocal quality used in rock, funk, and blues solos.

products.title: Ernie Ball Guitar Strings
products.description: Nickel-wound guitar strings designed for balanced tone and reliable playability. They provide a bright yet smooth sound with good flexibility for bending and strumming, making them a trusted choice for electric guitars.

products.title: Fender Guitar Cable
products.description: Durable instrument cable for connecting electric guitars and amplifiers. Its shielded construction reduces noise and interference, while the sturdy connectors and flexible jacket keep your signal clean and reliable.

products.title: Hercules Guitar Stand
products.description: Stable guitar stand for safe storage at home, rehearsal rooms and studios. Its secure support keeps your instrument upright and protected, and the foldable design is easy to carry and quick to set up.

products.title: Korg Chromatic Tuner
products.description: Compact chromatic tuner for accurate and convenient instrument tuning. Its clear display and fast response make it simple to tune guitars, basses, and other instruments quickly, even on a busy stage.

products.title: Mackie Mix8 Audio Mixer
products.description: Compact analog mixer for microphones, instruments and small audio setups. It offers simple gain and EQ controls with clean sound, perfect for small rehearsals, home studios, and live performances.

products.title: Focusrite Scarlett Solo Interface
products.description: USB audio interface for recording microphones and instruments at home. It provides clean preamps, a direct instrument input, and headphone monitoring, so you can record vocals and guitar with studio-quality sound.

products.title: Roland TR-08 Rhythm Composer
products.description: Compact rhythm machine for beat making, practice and electronic music production. It recreates the classic TR-808 drum sounds with hands-on step sequencing, letting you build grooves quickly in a portable design.

products.title: Shure SM7B Studio Microphone
products.description: Professional dynamic microphone designed for vocals, podcasting and studio recording. Its smooth, warm sound and strong rejection of background noise have made it a favorite for broadcast, singing, and spoken word.

products.title: Fender Player Jazz Bass
products.description: Versatile electric bass guitar with a comfortable feel and powerful classic tone. Its slim neck and dual pickups provide a wide range of sounds, from deep, warm lows to punchy, articulate highs for any genre.

products.title: Yamaha HS5 Studio Monitor
products.description: Compact studio monitor with clear, accurate sound for music production and mixing. Its flat, honest response helps you hear problems in your mix, and the small size fits comfortably in home studios.
